manifest.title: External futures data still does not clear the A+ strategy gate
manifest.description: Technical audit of passive-entry execution and Binance futures flow and positioning hypotheses against the strict-42 PolyMomentum strategy evidence.

blocks.body: # External futures data still does not clear the A+ strategy gate

## Answer first

The retained `0.30` volatility-floor strategy remains profitable at measured latency (`102` trades, `+$13.54`) but below A+. Trade-print passive entry produced only six defensible fills and remained negative on covered tail trades. Binance futures taker flow worsened both proper scores in both chronological halves. Lagged positioning improved aggregate Brier and log loss, but reversed negative in the second half, failed both bootstrap lower bounds, and still raised probability on known losses. **No strategy parameter or production path changed; live trading remains off.**

## Positioning has signal, but not stable signal

Direction-aligned top-trader position crowding plus 15-minute open-interest change improves the aggregate scores and the first half. The second half gives the improvement back. The chart shows the sign reversal directly; this violates the predeclared requirement that both proper scores improve in both halves.

## Real trade prints reject the synthetic maker assumption

Only `26 / 40` tail trades had retained full trade tape. Nineteen orders remained post-only eligible after `202 ms`; six had defensible full fills, all from explicit price-through SELL prints. The maker-or-skip counterfactual improved the covered tail from `-$7.81` to `-$5.24` but remained negative. The engine's fixed `0.65` maker-fill probability is therefore not promotion evidence.

## Method and causality

Both futures screens use a ridge logistic meta-label with executable Polymarket price as a log-odds offset. Each resolved condition has total weight one. After eight warm-up folds, ridge is selected on the final two strictly prior folds, the model is refit on all prior folds, and the next fold is scored once. Futures flow uses only fully closed prior minutes. Positioning uses a full five-minute publication buffer. All 28 Binance archives were checksum-verified. No feature subset, direction, lag, or threshold was selected after seeing outcomes.

## Limitations and uncertainty

The opportunity-complete cohort is historical and the latest fully warmed resolved block remains too small for promotion. A read-only VPS check on July 15 found zero shared distilled files, zero shared raw parquets, and only three PolyMomentum-private July 14 distilled hours. Positioning's aggregate gain is not independent because the feature family was evaluated on the same strict window used for diagnosis. Its 95% condition-bootstrap intervals cross zero, and the final validation selects ridge `10`, shrinking both standardized positioning coefficients below `0.004`. The forward model is authorized only for prospective scoring, never entry decisions.

## Next concrete run

1. Keep `primary_v6_volfloor_300` unchanged and research-only.
2. Stop historical feature and threshold mining on the strict-42 block.
3. Score the frozen positioning diagnostic without refitting on at least `100` new fully resolved conditions.
4. Require positive Brier and log-loss improvement and a non-positive mean correction on losses.
5. Repeat on a second disjoint fresh block before materializing one exact strategy variant.
6. Preserve unchanged A+ gates and `LIVE_TRADING_OFF` until the exact replay and fresh blocks pass.
